changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: workspace.mentor_enabled and workspace_agent_binding are required to carry the Heph setting over

changeSet.sql: UPDATE workspace_agent_binding SET enabled = false, updated_at = now() WHERE purpose = 'MENTOR' AND enabled = true AND workspace_id IN (SELECT id FROM workspace WHERE mentor_enabled = false)

rollback.stop: Which Heph bindings were on before the upgrade is not recorded; restore a pre-upgrade database backup.

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: activity_event and issue.author_id are required to attribute merges

changeSet.sql: UPDATE activity_event SET actor_id = issue.author_id FROM issue WHERE activity_event.event_type = 'PULL_REQUEST_MERGED' AND activity_event.target_type = 'pull_request' AND activity_event.target_id = issue.id AND issue.author_id IS NOT NULL AND activity_event.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM issue.author_id

UPDATE activity_event SET actor_id = NULL FROM issue WHERE activity_event.event_type = 'PULL_REQUEST_MERGED' AND activity_event.target_type = 'pull_request' AND activity_event.target_id = issue.id AND issue.author_id IS NULL AND activity_event.actor_id IS NOT NULL

rollback.stop: Who merged each pull request is not recorded on the event; restore a pre-upgrade database backup.
